repair.title: Repair Hole
repair.emptyLede: Measure damaged areas and calculate volume, material and mixing batches.
repair.selectHolesHint: Select at least one hole to calculate material.
repair.estimatedVolumeInfo: Best-guess cavity volume from your depth measurements. Choose this for an exact material calc when you accept less safety buffer. Work margin still applies on top.
repair.planningVolumeInfo: Default for material calc. Upper end of the geometry uncertainty range × work margin — safer amount to mix and buy when depths are incomplete or uncertain.
repair.calcBasisHintPlanning: Material is calculated from planning volume (upper estimate × work margin).
repair.calcBasisHintEstimated: Material is calculated from estimated volume (exact cavity × work margin).
repair.workMarginHint: Extra material for practical losses. Separate from geometry uncertainty.
repair.workMarginInfo:
Extra material for practical losses such as spill, waste, or uneven fill. Separate from the geometry uncertainty range.

Common values:
• 0% — careful / exact work
• 5–10% — typical field repair
• 15–20% — messy access or high waste risk

repair.incompleteDepth: Enter depths on each hole to see totals.
repair.irregularHint: Drag points to match the outline. Tap an edge to add a point.
repair.depthPointsInfo: Choose how many depth samples to place. More points raise confidence when the floor is uneven. Exact is for a flat, even floor (one depth), or two edge depths when fall is on.
repair.tapDepthPoint: Tap a point to enter depth.
repair.depthProgressiveHint: You can continue with fewer points — more measurements improve confidence.
repair.flatBottomHint: Flat, even floor — one depth measurement, high confidence (real measurement, not an estimate).
repair.flatBottomDepthHint: Enter the measured depth once — it applies to the whole floor.
repair.flatBottomEdgeLocked: Edge profile is Uniform — exact depth uses the measured value as truth.
repair.exactSlopeHint: Exact fall: only start and end edge points — two measured depths.
repair.exactSlopeDepthHint: Measure start and end of the fall — both edges are required for high confidence.
repair.edgeCoverHint: 0 mm = sharp edge (no slope). Increase to slope the rim inward to full depth.

repair.slopeHint: Places points in fall lines: start edge, interior, end edge aligned. One edge is often 0 mm.
repair.slopeDepthHint: Measure along each fall line — shallow edge can be 0 mm. More detail adds more lines.
repair.slopeEdgeLocked: Edge profile is Uniform — the fall is measured at the edges.
